revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - lin13 reading Αὐιλ is clear from the image; lin22 πειδ at the edge of the papyrus is clear; lin29 I suspect that in [Σ]ο〚υͅ〛υχᾶς the upsilon with iota subscript is a mistake for a simple upsilon, otherwise this suggestion is fine; lin31 good catch the the first two letters are missing.

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Lin10=> Διογε[νί]δι; lin13: I think Αὐιλ is legible on digital image (http://www.psi-online.it/documents/psi;3;161); lin22 yes, I can see πειδεδ̣ω̣κα; in reg=> [ἐ]πιδέδωκα; lin29: agree omicron clear; lin31 agree ἴσ in lacuna.

Z. 10): [παρ᾽] → [ὑπ᾽] (Anpassung an F. Mitthof, Tyche 17 [2002] 253); μεμμίαν → Μεμμίαν (Großschreibung, im Apparat ebenso). Z. 11: προκιμένην → l. προκειμένην. Z. 13/14: Αὐλ|[λί]ας → Αὐιλ|[λί]ας (am Photo; wohl Druckfehler in der Edition; vgl. schon Preisigke, Namenbuch, Sp. 66, der s.n. Αὐ<ι>λλίας konjizierte). Z. 22: ἐπιδέδωκα → [ἐ]πειδέδ̣ω̣κα (l. ἐπιδέδωκα) (am Photo). Z. 22/23: πρό|[κι]ται → l. πρό|[κει]ται. Z. 29: [Ἡ]σ ̣υχᾶς → [Σ]ο〚υͅ〛υχᾶς (am Photo; das Omikron ist absolut sicher). Z. 31: ἴσον → [ἴσ]ον (am Photo).
